-- What a client importing `Proof.github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.MembersAuthDefs` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def etcdstart.bootPremiseOn (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List
    w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id : w64) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ cfg U γ,
        ⌜etcdstart.cfgOkOn token name cfg ∧ Uok U ∧ γ.vs = ps ∧ γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) bootLog ∧ γ.boot = bootLog⌝ -∗
          bootstrapContract cfg U γ id ctxs N dir)

def etcdstart.cfgOkOn (token name : GoString) (cfg : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.config.ServerConfig)
    : Prop :=
  etcdstart.cfgOk token name cfg ∧ cfg.AuthToken' = go!"simple"

theorem etcdstart.memberUpOn_tok [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ :
    apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames GF) (id : w64) (γa : auth.AuthNames) (m : lease.Mode :=
    lease.Mode.none) : etcdstart.memberUpOn s ρ E₀ lg γn id γa m ⊢ threadTok ∗ (threadTok -∗
    etcdstart.memberUpOn s ρ E₀ lg γn id γa m)

def etcdstart.memberPreOn (N : Nat) (token : GoString) (ms : List etcdstart.GMember) (ps : List w64)
    (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (Φs : w64 → w64 →
    List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (γn : NetNames GF) (x : etcdstart.GMember × etcdstart.MemberG GF) (m
    : lease.Mode := lease.Mode.none) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(etcdstart.bootPremiseOn N ps bootLog ctxs dir token x.fst.Name' (etcdstart.urlsN ms x.fst) x.snd.id ∗
      etcdstart.memberBootOn x.snd.γ ctxs x.snd.ρ x.snd.E Φs x.snd.id false m ∗
        netHttpOk γn x.snd.id ∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes x.fst.Name' { peer := some x.fst.Peer' } γn)

theorem etcdstart.bootPremiseOn_persistent (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs :
    List (List w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id
    : w64) : Persistent (etcdstart.bootPremiseOn N ps bootLog ctxs dir token name Uok id)
